recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Preserve the existing registry URL pattern and download links; any future desire to add literal full URLs to every registry row should be treated as a new presentation decision rather than unfinished FHIR-13177 work.
issue_request: FHIR-13177 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request raised against DSTU2 and applied for STU3. It asked the specification to list the URL for all SearchParameter definitions, with the search parameter registry suggested as the likely location.
initial_application: The issue was applied by svn revision 12623, now git commit 504cee29eb827a96d411702c84b3059fa843cbc5, whose message is '#13177 - improve search parameter registry'. That commit added the canonical URL pattern http://hl7.org/fhir/SearchParameter/[id] and added an Id column to source/searchparameter-registry.html.
additional_context: The Zulip background thread confirms the request concerned canonical URLs such as http://hl7.org/fhir/SearchParameter/Organization-name. source/hierarchy.xml includes searchparameter-registry.html in the RESTful API page hierarchy. A later same-family issue, FHIR-34088, asked for direct canonical URL exposure in resource/common search tables and is already represented on the combined branch by commit 3c1993a14883b739545e3fc24d50ce96464c82da.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The registry still states the canonical URL pattern, lists each SearchParameter id, and links generated XML/JSON downloads whose SearchParameter resources contain full url values.
